question: I submitted my PGWP application in October 2024. Do I have to show language test results?
expected_facts: submitted your PGWP application before November 1, 2024 ... exempt from the new requirements

question: I started a program in June 2024 at a private college that delivers a public college's program in the same province. Can I get a PGWP?
expected_facts: began one of these programs after May 15, 2024, you're not eligible

question: Can I take my whole program online from outside Canada and still be eligible for a PGWP?
expected_facts: complete at least 50% of your program within Canada

question: I studied 4 months at a school that isn't a DLI and then 6 months at a DLI. Can I get a PGWP?
expected_facts: Only the time you spent studying at the DLI will be counted
at least 8 months at the DLI
fact_keys: only the time you spent studying at the DLI

question: My study permit had already expired when I applied for my PGWP. Can I work while I wait for the decision?
expected_facts: Your study permit must be valid (not expired) at the time you submit your application

question: My passport expires before my PGWP would. Once I get a new passport, can I extend my PGWP online?
expected_facts: you must apply on paper

question: I'm on an authorized leave from my studies. Can I keep working off campus?
expected_facts: you can't work off campus
only return to work once you resume your studies

question: Can I start working off campus a few weeks before my study program begins?
expected_facts: You can't work before your studies begin
fact_keys: can't work before your studies begin

question: My scholarship covers only my tuition. Is that enough proof of funds for my study permit?
expected_facts: provide other documents proving you have sufficient funds to cover living expenses and transportation costs

question: My program is 3 years long. Do I only need to show money for the first year of my studies?
expected_facts: tell us how you plan to pay for the full duration of your studies

question: Can I use English test results that are 3 years old for my Express Entry application?
expected_facts: Your test results must be less than 2 years old

question: I live in Canada and work remotely for a company in another country. Does that count for the Canadian Experience Class?
expected_facts: physically in Canada and working for a Canadian employer

question: Can I count money in my spouse's own bank account as proof of funds for Express Entry?
expected_facts: You may be able to count money in an account under your spouse's name only, but you must prove you have access

question: I'm 60 years old. Do I have to take the Canadian citizenship test?
expected_facts: between 18 and 54 years old ... must take the citizenship test

question: Can I wear perfume to my citizenship ceremony?
expected_facts: You cannot wear scented products

question: Can I sign my oath or affirmation form the day before my citizenship ceremony?
expected_facts: sign this form on the day you take the oath of citizenship, not the day before or after

question: After I become a citizen, can I travel abroad and come back to Canada using my old PR card?
expected_facts: you must have a Canadian passport to travel abroad and return to Canada

question: Can I get a Canadian visitor visa when I land at the airport in Canada?
expected_facts: You cannot obtain one upon arrival in Canada

question: I'm from a visa-exempt country. Do I need an eTA if I drive into Canada from the US?
expected_facts: do not need an eTA when arriving by car

question: I got a new passport. Is the eTA linked to my old passport still valid for my next flight?
expected_facts: If you get a new passport, you need to get a new eTA

question: My family members lost their status too. Can we restore it with one application and one fee?
expected_facts: they must each apply separately
There is no group or family rate

question: My work permit and status expired. Can I apply straight for a different kind of permit without restoring first?
expected_facts: you must restore your initial permit and status first

question: I hold Canadian citizenship but I work in Dubai right now. Is it possible for me to sponsor my wife for permanent residence?
expected_facts: you must show that you plan to live in Canada when the people you're sponsoring become permanent residents
